input.quote: This Agreement shall be automatically renewed for an additional one year period on each anniversary of the Effective Date, unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other.
input.rationale: Section 4.1 provides automatic one-year renewals, which is acceptable, but the non-renewal notice window is 90 days — above the fallback maximum of 60 days and at the edge of walk-away territory. Fees are a fixed 30% revenue share with no renewal uplift mechanic, so the price-increase cap element is not engaged. We therefore shorten only the Company's notice requirement to 60 days, keeping HDI's 90-day notice (longer notice to us is favourable) and the 12-month renewal term intact.

mappings.element: If renewal is automatic, Customer's non-renewal notice window is no more than 60 days.
If renewal permits price increases, each increase is capped at 5 percent.
mappings.quote: The Company shall pay HDI thirty percent (3016) of the Net Sales in excess of Eleven Thousand Dollars ($11,000) per calendar month.

proposal.summary: Shorten the Company's non-renewal notice window from 90 to 60 days while preserving HDI's 90-day notice.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We shortened our non-renewal notice window from 90 to 60 days, which is our fallback maximum for automatic renewals, and left HDI's 90-day notice obligation unchanged.

ops.newText: unless terminated by the Company upon sixty (60) days, or by HDI upon ninety (90) days, prior written notice to the other
